coverage_rule: exact normalized written form + exact normalized reading
level_policy: retain external consensus as an estimated learning band; annotate conflicts; do not suppress a valid exact surface form because of level disagreement
meaning_policy: Traditional Chinese only; exact source/JMdict sense first; pin broad homographs when intended sense is clear; hold unresolved source-sense conflicts

explicit_holds.いえ|いえ: source says TODO/same-as-いいえ while the exact form also represents house/no senses; source intent is unresolved
explicit_holds.ド|ド: source gloss says child/servant/foolishness but exact JMdict ド is the emphatic prefix extreme/ultra/very; material source-sense conflict
explicit_holds.あくび|悪日: unusual reading/form collides with common 欠伸（あくび）; require independent dictionary/source confirmation before publishing

known_malformed_source_rows_resolved.かげつ|ヶ月: source placeholder #NAME? replaced by verified counter-for-months sense
known_malformed_source_rows_resolved.さい|歳: source placeholder #NAME? replaced by verified age-counter sense
